purpose: xg-dino tickets 01 and 01b: the frozen A/B/C ablation protocol, written before any real fit

features.excluded_from_confirmatory: SoccerNet flags and every quality covariate (ball source, shot_from_ball, shooter_by_net, detection flags, counts, keypoint confidence, sanitation indicators)

model.class: L2 logistic regression on the standardised design, Newton (xgpoc.stack.fit.logistic_fit)
model.penalty: lambda = 1/C on every design column except the one named z_g_combo (xgpoc.dino.ablation.NamedModel); B_DA and B have every column penalised
model.inner_cv: C chosen inside each outer training fold over the other host folds, summed inner held-out log-loss, ties to the smaller C (xgpoc.stack.fit.chosen_c); arms without a penalised column (A) need none; a grid-edge flag per fold (smallest or largest C)
model.recalibration: none beyond each arm's own per-outer-fold logistic fit: A is a Platt fit on z per outer fold; B and C get no extra Platt layer; calibration slope and intercept reported
model.folds: the host folds of cache/folds_xgv_home5.csv (5), shared by every arm and block

metrics: delta log-loss among goals and among non-goals
delta log-loss standardised to the primary goal rate

tost.rule: P(d <= -delta) <= alpha and P(d >= delta) <= alpha over the draws (xgpoc.vendor.ladder.equivalence_curve)
tost.curve: margins 0 to 0.01 step 1e-4, smallest equivalent margin reported

C-B: 'DINOv2 adds' if the one-sided superiority test is Holm-rejected and the one-sided 95% upper bound < 0
else 'equivalent for this stacker at δ = 0.002' if the 90% interval lies within ±0.002
else 'inconclusive at δ = 0.002; smallest margin shown = X'
decision_table.C-A: 'geometry adds over the image' if Holm-rejected (one-sided)

leak_controls.estimand: the primary out-of-fold predictions restricted to the subsets, no refit, the primary draws
leak_controls.verdict: 'not decidable' if a heterogeneity 95% interval excludes 0 or the restricted no_v3 C-B 95% interval excludes the primary point estimate; else 'decidable'
leak_controls.unseen: descriptive (outcome-selected): goal / non-goal split and the sensitivity standardised to the primary goal rate
leak_controls.refit: each subset refitted on its own (as xgs_detector_leak.py), descriptive

subsets.no_v3: matches without any soccernet_v3 image in the detector pool index
subsets.unseen: results/xgs_stack_dd2c_leak/seen.csv seen = false (v3 pool image within 3 s)

truth.plus_0.002: not constructible: C nests B, its oracle C-B is <= 0

expected_precision.size_check: the 172 descriptive sweep's stack ALL interval scaled to 7,062 shots (C2)
expected_precision.reading: a straddle of ±δ is the likely outcome; worded as C1 ('inconclusive at δ = 0.002; smallest margin shown = X')

probes.fit: only on automatic geometry targets (feet_t0 E3) of the 328 matches; on the 2,721 paired shots the frozen probe predictions and the detector are evaluated against StatsBomb targets, nothing fitted to StatsBomb
probes.routing: outer fold k: probe fitted on fold model k's embeddings of folds != k (inner 3 for the penalty), read on fold k; frozen DINOv2 on the same splits; paired shots read with each fold model's probe, averaged
probes.gk_strata: goalkeeper targets also by detected / proxy strata

best_layer.metric: mean out-of-fold metric of the embedding-only probe per encoder x target: R² (continuous / count), AUC (binary)
best_layer.tie: within 0.01 R² / 0.005 AUC of the maximum -> the later block
best_layer.encodes_ci: the layer is selected inside the training folds (nested)
best_layer.paired: the layer chosen on all development out-of-fold readings

encodes_beyond_distance.rule: distance + embedding over the distance-only probe, 95% match-bootstrap lower bound > 0 and gain >= threshold

encodes_thresholds.else: does not encode at this threshold

agreement.right: |error| <= τ, the same τ for both sources
agreement.detector_wrong: |error| > τ and above the detector's own 75th percentile (C1)

timing_bands.merge: a band below 100 shots merges with its lower neighbour

cell_permutation_null.strata: 10 distance deciles of the paired shots, a stratum below 100 merged
cell_permutation_null.permuted: the probe's right / wrong status within stratum, the detector's status fixed

frozen.statsbomb: never read: every input path and the read-out run inside xgpoc.detector.guard.no_statsbomb_reads
disclosures: Development comparisons on the 328 training matches, not an independent test: the 172 held-out matches are spent; the descriptive row on them (frozen test models) is the size check.
G-combo's epoch and temperature were chosen on each scored fold (C6 disclosure 3): A and C carry optimism that B does not, so C-B is tilted toward 'DINOv2 adds'.
Stacking provenance: the training-fold z values of the stacker come from G-combo models that saw the scored fold (C6 disclosure).
The retrained detector dd2c (feet_t0 geometry) was trained on SoccerNet-v3 pool frames of 3,813 of the 7,062 shots, more often goals; the no_v3 and unseen controls (D1, C1) cannot resolve δ.
results/xgs_stack_feet_t0 used the historical feet_t0_own_flags variant (scripts/feet_rerun.py), not the frozen feet_t0 rule with E3's t0 ball-source flags used here; it is not an exact baseline.
E3's configuration was chosen on 135 of the 172 held-out matches by StatsBomb position error, with no outcomes.
The control simulations are label-free (C1 departure 1, accepted by C2): the truths are the geometry projection of z and its image-specific residual, not a fit of C on the real labels.
Under the label-free null B is exactly well-specified, so the null C-B half-width (0.00047 at r200) is a floor of the real precision (C2).
shooter_by_net (a no-ball shooter-pick flag) and the detection flags (homography_ok, shooter_ok, teams_ok, gk_ok, gk_detected, gk_proxy) count as quality covariates, not geometry (C1 departure 2).
B_DA is the C6 spec minus ball_none@0 (ball source is a quality covariate; C1 departure 3).
The kept gk_*_missing indicators carry gk_detected by construction (the C1 compromise).

'DINOv2 adds' needs both a Holm rejection of the one-sided C-B test and its one-sided 95% upper bound < 0 (C1 departure 4); the raw superiority and TOST flags are reported separately beside the headline (C2).
Linearly dependent columns are reduced only in the unpenalised oracle projections of the controls (duplicated missing indicators make them singular), never in the arms (C1 departure 5).
The procedure's C-B carries a known overfit shift under the null (+0.00013 at r200; C2): no bias correction; the 90% interval is kept unless the boundary false-equivalence rate exceeds 0.05.
A true C-B of +0.002 cannot be simulated: C nests B, so the oracle C-B is <= 0 (disclosed, no control).
